info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Drivers-v5-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Drivers API provides access to a list of drivers associated with food delivery operations. This endpoint is designed for food delivery service platforms, enabling them to retrieve information about available drivers, their status, and other relevant details. Developers integrating this API can streamline driver assignment and improve overall delivery efficiency. Typical consumers include logistics managers and application developers looking to enhance their delivery service offerings.

get.summary: Retrieve deliveries assigned to a specific driver
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of deliveries that are currently assigned to a specific driver. The response includes details about each delivery, enabling tracking and management.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving driver delivery operations. This payload should contain necessary information to query for driver deliveries based on specified criteria.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of drivers.
